name: Ambush on the road
win: the runner is captured (combat:captured) and the ambush driven off
lose: the runner escapes, the client falls, or you are downed

phases.name: Pin down
phases.behaviour: a three-person cell in road clothes and face scarves holds the road with smoke, makibishi and a fire-and-wind combo while a runner flees
phases.openings: bind, possess, wire or a shuriken to the legs stops the runner

phases.name: Mines
phases.behaviour: paper-bomb mines across the road and tagged kunai
phases.openings: wind or a flash shows the mines; a sealing tag captures a downed foe

notes: Teaches enemy cells, smoke and paper bombs, capture with a sealing tag

scripted.what: an area-denial line across the pursuit path
